names.details: Ḫārik: An island in the Baḥr-i Fārs (Persian Gulf), located near ‘Abādān (Abadan, Iran). It is said that pearls are found in its waters. [translation]

title: Arakia (island)
provenance: Barrington Atlas: BAtlas 93 G4 Arakia? Ins.
description: An island in the Persian Gulf, probably to be identified with the island of Kharg.
